SCAM ALERT:  DO NOT PURCHASE:  I wish there was a big fat zero to click on.  On October 12, 2026  I ordered the 5-jar bundle. Promotional deal offers buy 3 get 2 free.  I saved (screen shot) the promotional add offering $16.95 each jar; Buy 3 @ $16.95 get two free. This is a tiny 2 ounce jar. You do the math. That totals $50.85 plus tax and I also paid $9.85 expedited shipping.  At check-out I was offered 3 jars for $12.50 each and I purchased 3. 
 Here is the result:  I was shipped (2) tiny 2 ounce jars for $37.50. The package was shipped ground. I received (2) 2 ounce jars of Tallow Honey Balm. Expedited shipping does not take 8 days and the order I paid $9.95 to ship to me expedited, was written as free shipping on my receipt. I have NOT received my (5) jars which I was charged $94.70 for.
 In Total I was charged $132.20 plus $9.95 expedited shipping. Invoice says “free shipping”. I believe TERRALOTUS took my money, then did not ship my main order. Luckily I saved the envelope it arrived in showing it was sent ground and proving not more than 2 jars would fit in this little envelope.  Once I say I have not received the order, they can claim Insurance on the very package they never intended to ship. I will say the product is very nice. BUT I was scammed. If you want someone to take your money, tell you a scam story of how the money adds up and never ship you the product, this is the company to do that. When I sent an email to Camille, she said you get 57% off the regular price and the add doesn’t mean you get 3 @ $16.95 and (2) free. I have pictures of every item purchased and I had a witness when I opened the package 8 days later, sent ground I paid $9.95 expedited, Insured shipping. My truth?  I fell 23-feet not long ago breaking my whole body including sternum and nose. Spinal injury at L2. Chronic Venius Insufficiency and gall bladder struggling. I do NOT need this headache. Also my accounts were all hacked after this purchase; savings, checking and debit card. Idk if was them but it’s Suss. Please don’t give yourself this headache. 
 DO NOT PURCHASE FROM THIS COMPANY
 SCAM ALERT SCAM ALERT
